knowledge:
- key_parameters: Dc=Matrix of total read counts where rows correspond to genomic loci and columns to samples ;; Dt=Matrix of alternative allele counts where rows correspond to genomic loci and columns to samples ;; C=The assumed number of clones ;; maxIt=Maximum number of EM iterations ;; binomTryNum=Number of models to train with different initial values to escape local optima ;; models=A list of trained models passed to choose.best() ;; doTalk=Boolean parameter in choose.best() to print progress messages
- alternatives: Upstream tools like BWA, Samtools, or DeepSNV are mentioned for mapping and computing counts, but no direct R package alternatives for clonal decomposition are named.
- when_to_use: Use when you have allele counts and total coverage counts from multiple spatial or temporal samples of a single tumor and want to resolve the underlying clonal genotypes and their frequencies.
- pitfalls: The EM algorithm is prone to local optima, requiring a large number of models (e.g., binomTryNum=1000) to be trained. Results of the Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC) analysis via compute.bic() to estimate clone numbers must be interpreted with great caution.

workflows.name: clonal_decomposition
workflows.intent: Infer clonal genotypes and frequencies from multi-sample tumor NGS count data using binomial models.
input: Dc (matrix of total read counts where rows are genomic loci and columns are samples)
Dt (matrix of alternative allele counts where rows are genomic loci and columns are samples)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the Clomial package and input count matrices ;; 2. Run the Clomial EM algorithm to train multiple models ;; 3. Select the best model based on likelihood using choose.best() ;; 4. Extract and inspect the estimated clonal genotypes (Mu) and clone frequencies (P)
workflows.code:
library(Clomial)
set.seed(1)
data(breastCancer)
Dc <- breastCancer$Dc
Dt <- breastCancer$Dt
Clomial2 <-Clomial(Dc=Dc,Dt=Dt,maxIt=20,C=4,binomTryNum=2)
model1 <- Clomial2$models[[1]]
round(model1$P,digits=2)
data(Clomial1000)
models <- Clomial1000$models
length(models)
chosen <- choose.best(models=models, doTalk=TRUE)
M1 <- chosen$bestModel
round(M1$Mu)
round(M1$P[,1],digits=2)
